supersedes_scope: Replaces the balanced-profile target scenarios with High-profile measurements. The balanced record remains the authoritative history of that capture and is not rewritten.
headline: First High content-profile reference capture at 9 scenarios. Frame-time percentiles, GPU memory, working set, and 30-minute sustained growth all pass with large margins. The ratified zero-stall limit fails in 4 scenarios (daylight, high-speed, steady-state-30m, streaming) across 12 steady-driving events. Three identical streaming runs produced 4, 0 and 0 events, so the failure is intermittent and no rate is established. Every event reports render CPU plus GPU near 1 ms, so the cost lies outside the measured render path and remains unattributed.

measurement_method.vsync: disabled for the matrix; a separate presentation-vsync scenario enables it
measurement_method.content: integrated visual slice: production Hero GT, production highway kit, High regional environment profile on the representative-corridor fixture
measurement_method.run_order: sequential, single pass, in the order listed under commands

target_alignment.declared_target: 2560x1440 High at a stable 60 FPS on the declared reference PC
target_alignment.renderer_preset_note: The repository still defines no separate High renderer preset; environment_quality controls content density only. This capture closes the High content-profile gap and leaves the renderer-preset gap open.

scenario_arguments.seed: engine default run seed 20260714 (this capture does not vary the seed)
scenario_arguments.deterministic_inputs: the route package is rebuilt from checksum-locked fixture sources before every run and compared across two builds

failures.note: All nine captures completed sequentially on the first attempt. The recorded threshold failures are measured results, not capture failures.

streaming_repeatability.purpose: Characterise the single 52.404 ms steady-driving stall recorded in the merged balanced baseline (Q-022a working default A).
streaming_repeatability.statistical_claim: Three runs establish a repeat count, not a confidence interval. No rate is claimed beyond the observed counts.

stall_characterisation.attribution: Every recorded stall reports render CPU plus render GPU far below the stall duration, so the cost is outside the measured render components. The harness has no per-subsystem counter, so no more specific cause is claimed here; Q-022c owns how attribution should be obtained.
